sents.text: Hello, and welcome to Learn AI the Right Way.
Before any lesson begins, let me take five minutes to show you the whole map: what you'll learn, how each lesson works, and the one short quiz you take before you start.
Here's the idea behind the name.
Most people jump straight to the exciting part, and get stuck on the basics underneath it.
We build the foundations first, you practise everything with your own hands, and you check your understanding at every step.
Everything is laid out in the course catalogue, linked in the description.
There are thirteen short courses, in six tracks.
Getting Started sets up your tools.
Python for Data teaches the Python, charts and statistics you need.
Then come Classical Machine Learning, and Neural Networks and Deep Learning.
Running Real ML Projects shows how real work gets done.
And the last track takes you into large language models and generative AI.
Before all of that sits Course zero, the prep course.
It covers the tools every AI engineer uses daily: the Linux command line, file permissions, Git, how a GPU and its drivers fit together, and Python basics.
The harder topics get a video.
The rest come as a one-page cheatsheet with a short quiz.
